title: Reverse Migration Validation

downgrade_results.behavior: Older schemas are auto-migrated forward by Drift — no SchemaVersionTooOldException exists. Only newer schemas (onDisk > currentSchemaVersion) are rejected via SchemaVersionTooNewException.
downgrade_results.exception_type_for_older_schemas: None — Drift migration handles forward migration

known_limitations: Older schemas are migrated forward by Drift — downgrade (opening old schema with new app) is not rejected
Backup verification uses file copy, not live DB WAL checkpoint
Downgrade rejection (SchemaVersionTooOldException) does not exist in codebase — older schemas are accepted and migrated
